status: source vocabulary for embedded actual oracle; no executed product or qualification result

validation_error_strings.validation_error_yield_time: invalid background checkpoint or yield time

domain_boundaries.retirement_inputs: disposition 3 uses Some(worker_retired), None checkpoint and not_before_ms=current episode.now for every captured original token; cancellation uses disposition 2; ordinary service uses contextual ordinary_settle payloads
domain_boundaries.resolution_read_boundary: resolve_claim is one logical actual-API pure-read action; its two authoritative QueueSql awaits and internal interleavings are a named conformance boundary, not closed read-interleaving coverage
domain_boundaries.primitive_clock_boundary: intrinsic primitives use current episode.now; ordinary_settle preserves its separately captured request_now_ms; retirement wall samples/internal dispatch races and zero-delay claim/renew-resolution envelopes remain named source/conformance boundaries
domain_boundaries.reservation_conservation_boundary: conservation is checked for unexpired queue authority only; expired Running rows and residue remain represented, with no independent complete-residue conservation guarantee until reclaim/prune
domain_boundaries.domain_reacquisition_boundary: each owner can acquire at most once; release or expiry does not reset its budget, so same-owner release-to-reacquire cycles are excluded
domain_boundaries.foreign_holder_boundary: foreign-holder is a third adversarial domain-lease owner, not either worker node, with one independent acquisition budget
domain_boundaries.retirement_sequence_boundary: the graph supplies separate actual settle and logical resolve primitives; daemon drain/local-token/first-settle/resolve/optional-second-settle sequencing is a reviewed source and daemon-conformance boundary composed by the temporal model
domain_boundaries.cleanup_boundary: local cleanup needs bounded retirement calls to return, not eventual successful acknowledgement; errors are logged and finish returns while durable authority may remain
domain_boundaries.dispatch_time_noninterference: for retirement fence Some(F), resolve_claim reads dispatched_at_ms only in its skipped fence-is-none window branch; neither SQL query nor later classification reads it, so a representative dispatch sample preserves results at fixed now/read outcomes; this is a reviewed source lemma, not a machine proof
domain_boundaries.queue_sql_boundary: all generated queue primitives use QueueSql::queue_sql, not queue_transaction; ReplyBoundary passes queue_transaction through without fault injection, so multi-statement transaction faults are outside this slice
domain_boundaries.schema_snapshot_boundary: canonical durable rows cover exactly the nine snapshot_tables; all installed schema objects are hash-bound for identity, not complete row snapshots or proofs of unrelated tables
domain_boundaries.savepoint_boundary: no closure transition invokes queue_transaction or nested explicit transactions; test savepoints bracket sequential primitives on the production writer and any savepoint/SQL failure aborts closure
domain_boundaries.refusal_observation: the extracted oracle retains the original full-canonical refused-edge equality guard before memoization; logical resolve retains durable read-only observation; no pre-existing closure gap is claimed
domain_boundaries.ordinary_settlement_payload_transfer: selected actual ordinary settlement payload/capture/request/local-service correspondence; evidence pending qualification; normal wall/mono input domain only
domain_boundaries.clock: wall and mono independently advance to the smallest strict greater nonnegative representable neighbour of retained exact authority/payload/queued-eligibility or source local-deadline anchors; no horizon clipping
domain_boundaries.renewal_resolution_boundary: selected zero-delay renewal plus actual logical resolve has no inner interleaving; both actual outcomes and capture references are certified; resolution errors consume the remaining per-attempt fault allowance
domain_boundaries.initial_claim_recovery_boundary: lost initial claims use actual fence-None resolution with original dispatch identity, conditional actual row reread or Cancel, and no inner query interleaving; at most eight persistent job/node/claim loss keys; inconclusive outcomes service exact 250ms source wakes until the fixed 30000ms local deadline; the separate Store request window is 120000ms
domain_boundaries.omitted_dv_state_boundary: selected library_scan/metadata_refresh inputs preserve empty files and DV demand, marker [(1,1)] and exact initialized dv_title_jobs_demand sqlite_sequence rows; omitted-state drift aborts the whole run without changing nine-table canonical identity

membership: intrinsic cancel/retirement settle2/3 and resolve use every captured token; renew/bind/complete use latest-per-claim; ordinary saved request and wall target membership are independently contextual
identity: raw production fixture UUIDs and all full canonical nine-table rows/Episode/action bytes are retained; hash equality never replaces full equality in oracle replay/cache
coverage: selected product demands only; no arbitrary Store-D closure or all-result-class coverage claim
execution_use: documentation-only registry; checker/TLA do not consume this file; no acceptance gate or executed statistics
cutoff_boundary: no_intrinsic_expiry_boundary describes only absent authority-expiry neighbours; it never excludes contextual payload/queued/monotonic clock movement

initial_claim_recovery.source_request: actual ClaimJob on every primitive, including refusal
initial_claim_recovery.oracle_read: full actual BackgroundJob; no Episode read-snapshot append
initial_claim_recovery.fault_domain: persistent unique job/node/claim_id loss keys, at most eight; no nonlost RPC count budget
initial_claim_recovery.source_timer: wake min(mono+250,issued+30000); separate Store resolution window 120000
initial_claim_recovery.primitive_summary: actual initial resolve then conditional read or Cancel; no inner interleaving
